articles.title: Avio to Launch Four Earth Observation Satellites for Taiwan
articles.summary:
The Taiwan Space Agency (TASA) has awarded Italian rocket builder Avio a launch contract for its FORMOSAT-8C and 8D, and FORMOSAT-9A and 9B Earth observation satellites. articles.title: Innospace plans second launch in 2026 after failure of first Hanbit-Nano rocket
articles.summary:
South Korea’s Innospace said it will attempt a second launch of its small rocket in the first half of 2026 after its inaugural flight failed shortly after liftoff Dec. 22.
